Hi Aisha — thanks for the clear list. We prepared a concise commercial appendix and a short worked example below. Full appendix attached. High level answers first, then numeric examples.

Quick answers:
- Unit: billing is per 1,000 tokens (combined input + output). We report input vs output separately in the invoice for visibility, but the charge unit is combined 1k tokens.
- True-up: monthly true-up to committed monthly volume. Overages billed monthly at the overage multiplier for the tier. Credits applied on the subsequent invoice when applicable.
- Smoothing/graceband: we offer a 10% per-month graceband for the first 3 months (no overage billed until exceedance >10% of commitment in a month) + one-time onboarding credit if a 12-month commit is signed.
- Overage multipliers: default 1.25x for tier 1, 1.30x for tier 2, 1.40x for lower commitments. We can cap at 1.25x for strategic accounts with a 12-month commit.
- Embeddings/fine-tuned: embeddings are a separate SKU; fine-tuned variants add a model-complexity premium (example: +20% for dedicated fine-tuned variants). Details in attached rate sheet.

Concise commercial options (examples use 1k-token unit):

1) Pay-as-you-go (no commit)
- Hosted base: $0.025 per 1k tokens (input+output combined)
- Embeddings: $0.018 per 1k embedding tokens
- No minimum; available immediately.

2) Committed monthly (recommended for predictable workloads)
- Tier A: 1M tokens/month commit: $0.020 / 1k (10% discount vs PAYG)
- Tier B: 5M tokens/month commit: $0.014 / 1k (44% discount vs PAYG)
- Tier C: 20M tokens/month commit: $0.010 / 1k (60% discount vs PAYG)
- Monthly true-up; overage multiplier default 1.30x (can cap to 1.25x with 12-month legal)

3) Fixed monthly retainer + reserved slab (Dedicated/Private pricing)
- Reserved slab (example): 50M tokens/month reserved at $0.008 / 1k; includes priority routing and 99.9% inference availability SLA; separate baseline monthly platform fee applies.
- Overage: 1.20x reserved rate.

Worked example (monthly accounting):
Assume 5M commit (Tier B) at $0.014 / 1k: committed units = 5,000,000 tokens
Actual usage in month: 6,000,000 tokens (20% over commit)
Graceband (10% month 1) reduces billed overage threshold to 5,500,000 tokens for month 1.
Billed overage = 6,000,000 - 5,500,000 = 500,000 tokens -> 500 * $0.014 * 1.30 = $9,100.
Committed portion billed = 5,000,000 / 1,000 * $0.014 = $70.00 * 1000? (see appendix for per-invoice formatting).

Notes and negotiation levers:
- We can offer a month-1 smoothing credit to cover spikes during ramp and a cap on overage multiplier for signed 12-month commitments.
- Pre-purchased token credits can be amortized over 12 months and are valid for 12 months from purchase.
- Embedding calls billed separately; heavy-embedding workloads can be carved out into an embedding commit at a blended rate.

Attached: Redwood_Commercial_Appendix_MegaCorp_v1.pdf and MACC_Rate_Sheet.xlsx (rate ladder + worked math).

If that level of detail works, I can send a DocuSign with a simple 12-month commit term sheet + Appendix and we can schedule a 30-minute call tomorrow to walk numbers.

Best,
